-- 1. Encontrar cobranças de ~961 com vencimento em março 2026 para o cliente Lucas
SELECT sc.id, sc.value, sc.dueDate, sc.status, sc.amountPaid, sc.paymentLinks, sc.asaasPaymentId, sc.subscriptionId
FROM subscription_charges sc
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscriptionId = s.id
INNER JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.clientId = ac.id
WHERE ac.name LIKE '%Lucas%'
  AND sc.value BETWEEN 900 AND 1000
  AND sc.dueDate BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
ORDER BY sc.dueDate;

-- 2. Encontrar cobranças-mãe de alto valor (>5000) para o mesmo cliente
SELECT sc.id, sc.value, sc.dueDate, sc.status, sc.type, sc.subscriptionId, ac.name as clientName
FROM subscription_charges sc
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON sc.subscriptionId = s.id
INNER JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.clientId = ac.id
WHERE sc.value > 5000
ORDER BY sc.value DESC
LIMIT 20;
